package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_mixes_html_json_and_file_responses: Handlers that serve fundamentally different transport modes from one function.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func ReportHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	format := c.Query("format")

	switch format {
	case "json":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
			"report": "summary",
			"count":  42,
		})
	case "html":
		c.HTML(http.StatusOK, "report.tmpl", gin.H{
			"title": "Monthly Report",
			"data":  "summary data",
		})
	case "pdf":
		c.File("./reports/summary.pdf")
	default:
		c.File("./reports/summary.pdf")
	}
}
